usedFor: MailChimp holds your audience, and Zoho Invoice stores billable people when a new subscriber triggers “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” in MailChimp, then “Create Contact” in Zoho Invoice
bestTemplate.why: Each new subscriber is ready to invoice later, with no second data entry in Zoho Invoice.

watchOut: Using the unsubscribe trigger with “Create Contact” would add people who just left your audience.
